Frequently Asked Questions

What is PlanBot?▼
PlanBot is an AI-powered daily planner app for Android that creates personalized plans for students, professionals, athletes, and entrepreneurs using advanced AI technology.
Is PlanBot free?▼
Yes. PlanBot is free to download with 2 AI plans per day. Paid plans start at ₹99/month for Pro tier.
What AI does PlanBot use?▼
PlanBot uses multiple advanced AI models across its tiers. Each tier unlocks a progressively more powerful AI engine — from basic AI (Free) to our most advanced AI (God tier).
Is PlanBot available on iPhone?▼
PlanBot is currently available on Android only. Download from the Google Play Store. iOS support is planned for the future.

About PlanBot AI & Our Mission

PlanBot is developed by PlannextTech, founded by Naitik Baldaniya. We are a team of productivity experts and developers committed to building advanced AI scheduling assistants. Our mission is to help Indian students (JEE, NEET), professionals, and athletes optimize their routines using adaptive multi-tier neural scheduling technology.

With a growing user base relying on our AI study planners and productivity tools, PlanBot sets the standard for personalized scheduling, habit building, and AI-driven time management. We prioritize user privacy, data-driven productivity improvement, and seamless mobile experiences.

Our Planning Methodology

Our productivity workflow methodology combines evidence-based productivity principles with advanced machine learning. By utilizing adaptive scheduling, PlanBot continually learns from your task completion rates, optimizing your focus time and enforcing schedule automation. It serves as a comprehensive productivity methodology engine designed to eliminate procrastination and maximize output.
